# proxmox_nodes (Data Source)

Lists cluster nodes from `/nodes`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

data "proxmox_nodes" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Static identifier for this data source.
- `nodes` (Attributes List) Cluster nodes visible to the authenticated user. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--nodes))
